# MechFlow Engineering Services and Solutions
> Kingdom-wide OEM-independent industrial engineering partner delivering rotating equipment overhauls, advanced sealing solutions, motor rewinding, plant turnarounds (TAR), Skid & Interconnecting Piping, Mechanical Construction, and Specialized Equipment Rentals across Saudi Arabia.

## Key Information
- Official Website: https://mechflow-saudi.com
- Arabic Portal: https://mechflow-saudi.com/ar/index.html
- Head Office: Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
- Regional Mobilization Hubs: Dammam (Eastern Province) & Yanbu (Al Madinah Province)

- Email: info@mechflow.sa

## Core Engineering Divisions (9 Specialized Divisions)
1. **Turbomachinery & Pumps**: Precision overhauls for steam turbines, gas turbines, API 610 multi-stage centrifugal pumps, and 10-Ton Schenck dynamic balancing (https://mechflow-saudi.com/turbomachinery.html).
2. **Fluid & Dry Gas Sealing**: API 682 and API 692 dry gas seals overhaul with dynamic nitrogen pressure testing up to 150 bar in Class 10,000 cleanroom (https://mechflow-saudi.com/fluid-gas-sealing.html).
3. **Plant Turnaround (TAR) & Shutdowns**: Turnkey shutdown maintenance execution, rotating equipment turnaround crews, 24/7 shift coverage, 0.00 LTI safety record (https://mechflow-saudi.com/plant-turnaround.html).
4. **Advanced Engineering & Reverse Engineering**: 3D optical laser scanning, CMM inspection, laser shaft alignment, in-situ dynamic balancing, and FEA stress verification (https://mechflow-saudi.com/advanced-engineering.html).
5. **Electrical Motors & Generators**: High-voltage motor rewinding up to 13.8 kV, Vacuum Pressure Impregnation (VPI), and ATEX/Ex explosion-proof overhauls (https://mechflow-saudi.com/electrical-motors.html).
6. **Heat Transfer & Exchangers**: Shell and tube heat exchangers retubing, hydrostatic pressure testing up to 300 bar, and high-pressure chemical hydro-jetting (https://mechflow-saudi.com/heat-transfer.html).
7. **Skid Piping & Interconnecting Piping**: ASME B31.3 modular process skid fabrication, high-pressure pipe spools (CS, SS, Duplex, Inconel), tie-ins to plant piperacks, and 100% NDT inspection (https://mechflow-saudi.com/services.html).
8. **Mechanical Construction & Erection**: Heavy rotating and static equipment rigging, structural steel erection, precision foundation epoxy grouting, and API 686 alignment (https://mechflow-saudi.com/services.html).
9. **Specialized Equipment Rental Fleet**: Rapid 2-4 hour deployment of hydrostatic test pumps up to 40,000 PSI, portable flange facers up to 120", hydraulic torque wrenches, and mobile laser alignment systems (https://mechflow-saudi.com/services.html).

## Standards & Compliance
- Piping & Pressure Codes: ASME B31.3, ASME B31.1, ASME Section VIII Div 1 & 2, ASME PCC-1
- Machinery & Seal Standards: API 610, API 611, API 612, API 617, API 670, API 682, API 686, API 692
- Quality & Safety Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, ISO 1940-1 (G1.0 / G2.5)
- Safety: 0.00 Lost Time Incident (LTI) track record across Saudi Aramco, SABIC, SEC, Ma'aden, and SWCC facilities.
